system.description:
Crash Evolution

| #### Crash (Perfected) / Will Amp / Once per casting, you gain a +5d10 bonus to damage you deal with Ninjutsu you cast. / You can use three or more Moldings at once as part of the same casting. / Your Ninjutsu treats immunity to their damage type like resistance. |

You push your chakra network to its limits outputting more than humanly possible.

9th Level. While in the Crash state, once per turn, when you cast a Ninjutsu, you roll 1d4 before applying its affects. On a roll of 4, one affected creature suffers a -4 penalty to their saving throw.

15th Level. While in the Crash state, you can use one Molding at no Focus cost, once every other turn.
